$description: trmnl-home design system tokens for non-TRMNL views (web, widget, desktop, terminal-adjacent surfaces). Style based on heimdalsecurity.com: friendly modern SaaS — deep navy, vivid pink CTAs, blue gradients, rounded shapes. Values extracted from Heimdal's production CSS on 2026-07-31. Every text/background pair prescribed here meets WCAG 2.1 AA; see design/README.md for the contrast rules and tests/test_design_tokens.py for the guard that enforces them.

changelog: 1.3.0 — Added icon.weather: the full 8-state weather icon set (sun, partly-cloudy, cloud, rain-light, rain, rain-heavy, thunder, snow) matching src/weather.py, each as a colorable SVG sprite symbol at icon-weather-<state>.

1.2.0 — Fixed cards rendering with no visible boundary on plain (untinted) sections: card-style components now border on border.strong instead of border.subtle, which no longer depends on the surrounding section's background. Fixed missing spacing between the gradient do/dont cards' description and the element below it. Added an icon token group (stroke width, a 4-step size scale) and an Iconography section to the style guide.
1.1.0 — Accessibility pass: added text.muted for light surfaces, per-state semantic surface/text pairs in both themes, border and focus tokens. text.secondary is now dark-surfaces-only.
1.0.0 — Initial palette, typography, shape, motion and gradient tokens extracted from heimdalsecurity.com.

pink.$description: Primary brand accent. CTA fills, active states. As text on white it is 3.56:1 — large/bold text or non-text UI only.

pink-deep.$description: Gradient end of the primary CTA gradient (with brand.pink).

navy.$description: Primary dark. Headings, dark sections, footer. 15.6:1 on white.

blue.$description: Secondary accent. Links, icons, interactive elements. 4.89:1 on white — AA for body text on surface.base, but not on surface.tinted (4.10:1); use semantic.info-text there.

blue-light.$description: Gradient start for blue gradients, decorative accents, and interactive text on dark surfaces.

purple.$description: Tertiary accent for tags, charts, differentiation. Non-text use on light; see semantic.purple-text for text.

purple-dark.$description: Deep purple for dark decorative surfaces.

tinted.$description: Pale lavender section tint, alternating bands.

primary.$description: Headings and body text on light surfaces. 15.6:1 on base, 13.1:1 on tinted.

muted.$description: Muted text on LIGHT surfaces: captions, metadata, secondary paragraphs, placeholders. 6.84:1 on surface.base and 5.74:1 on surface.tinted — both AA. Use this, never text.secondary, on light.

secondary.$description: Muted text on DARK surfaces only: navy bands, dark theme, terminal backgrounds. 7.52:1 on brand.navy. It is 2.07:1 on white — never use it on a light surface.

subtle.$description: Hairline dividers and card outlines on light surfaces. Decorative only — never the sole carrier of meaning.

strong.$description: Input borders, dashed empty-state outlines, and any border a user must perceive to operate a control. 3.60:1 on surface.base and 3.02:1 on surface.tinted — clears the 3:1 WCAG 1.4.11 floor for non-text UI, which border.subtle does not.

ring.$description: Focus-visible outline color on light surfaces.

ring-dark.$description: Focus-visible outline color on dark surfaces and in the dark theme.

ring-offset.$description: Gap between element and focus ring. Ring itself is 3px solid.

semantic.$description: Each state carries three tokens: <state> is the fill/indicator color (non-text use), <state>-surface is an accessible tinted background, and <state>-text is a foreground that meets AA on both that surface and surface.base. Solid fills with white text fail AA for every state except none — use the surface/text pair for badges, alerts and any state text.

success.$description: Completed, done, positive states. Fill/dot only — 1.99:1 against white text.

success-surface.$description: Tinted background for success badges and alerts on light surfaces.

success-text.$description: Success foreground. 5.33:1 on success-surface, 5.86:1 on surface.base.

success-bright.$description: Bright variant for dots and highlights on dark surfaces. Never text on light.

warning.$description: Warnings, due-soon states. Fill/indicator only — 3.05:1 against white text.

warning-surface.$description: Tinted background for warning badges and alerts.

warning-text.$description: Warning foreground. 5.42:1 on warning-surface, 6.34:1 on surface.base.

error.$description: Errors and failed states. Reuses the deep pink-red. Fill/indicator only — 3.78:1 against white text.

error-surface.$description: Tinted background for error badges and alerts.

error-text.$description: Error foreground. 5.03:1 on error-surface, 6.18:1 on surface.base.

info-surface.$description: Tinted background for info badges and alerts.

info-text.$description: Info foreground. 6.16:1 on info-surface, 7.56:1 on surface.base. Also the safe link color on surface.tinted.

accent-surface.$description: Tinted background for brand-pink badges and highlights.

accent-text.$description: Brand-pink foreground. 4.84:1 on accent-surface, 5.86:1 on surface.base. Use where brand.pink would be text.

purple-surface.$description: Tinted background for purple badges (anniversaries, differentiation).

purple-text.$description: Purple foreground. 5.23:1 on purple-surface, 6.18:1 on surface.base.

cta.$description: Primary CTA button gradient. White text on it is 3.56:1 — AA only at large/bold sizes, which is why buttons are 16px bold.

blue.$description: Blue decorative gradient (icons, hero art, charts). Never behind text.

dark.$description: Dark theme overrides. Apply on top of the light defaults; brand accents (pink, gradients) are unchanged. Page background goes deeper than brand.navy; cards/panels use raised. Interactive text (links, times) switches to blue-light, and muted text switches back to text.secondary — the value that is unusable on light is exactly the right one here.

base.$description: Dark page background, deeper than brand.navy.

primary.$description: Headings and body on dark surfaces. 19.0:1 on dark base.

muted.$description: Muted text on dark. 9.20:1 on dark base, 7.43:1 on raised. Replaces text.muted, which is too dark here.

interactive.$description: Links, secondary buttons, highlighted values on dark. 9.94:1 on dark base (brand.blue would be 3.89:1).

border-strong.$description: Input borders and perceivable control outlines on dark surfaces. Composites to 3.50:1 on surface.base and 3.21:1 on surface.raised.

semantic.$description: Dark-theme replacements for the semantic surface/text pairs. Surfaces are the state color mixed into the dark base; foregrounds are lightened until they clear AA on that surface, on surface.base and on surface.raised.

display.$description: Headings, numbers, display text. Rounded geometric feel.

size.$description: Display sizes are fluid: the value here is the desktop maximum, and the style guide sets them with clamp() so they scale down to the min noted in each $description. Body sizes are fixed.

caption.$description: Captions, metadata (14px). Never smaller — 14px is the floor.

3xl.$description: Section padding on desktop; drops to 2xl below 900px and xl below 600px.

breakpoint.$description: Mobile-first breakpoints used by every non-TRMNL view. Layouts must survive 375px with no horizontal scroll.

mobile.$description: Below this: single column, section nav collapses to a horizontal scroller, section padding drops to spacing.xl.

tablet.$description: Below this: side navigation stacks above content, section padding drops to spacing.2xl.

icon.$description: Hand-drawn line icons, 24x24 grid, rounded caps and joins to match the brand's friendly geometry. Icons carry no fill and no hardcoded stroke color — they inherit `currentColor`, so a single icon recolors by setting the CSS `color` property (text.primary by default, text.muted for de-emphasized icons, brand.blue/interactive for active/clickable icons). A meaningful icon (one that carries information a word doesn't repeat nearby, e.g. a status glyph with no adjacent label) must still clear the same 3:1 non-text contrast floor as any other UI boundary — see the Accessibility section.

strokeWidth.$description: Fixed stroke width on the 24x24 grid for every icon in the set, regardless of the rendered size. Do not scale stroke width with icon size — it reads as a weight change, not a size change.

sm.$description: Inline with caption text (14px) and dense list metadata.

md.$description: Default UI icon size: inline with body text, inside buttons and form fields.

lg.$description: Standalone icon chips, section headers, nav icons. The grid's native size.

xl.$description: Empty states and weather glyphs — the largest size before an icon should become a full illustration.

weather.$description: The complete set of weather states produced by src/weather.py and rendered as 1-bit glyphs in the TRMNL templates (templates/devices/og.liquid, x.liquid). Each token's value is the exact string src/weather.py returns as `weather.icon` (and the daily forecast's `day.icon`); the design/index.html sprite defines a matching symbol at id `icon-weather-` + that value, e.g. `icon-weather-rain-light` for the rain-light token. A view maps data straight to a glyph with no lookup table: `#icon-weather-${weather.icon}`.

motion.$description: Animation tokens. Motion is subtle and functional: short, ease-out, and always honor prefers-reduced-motion. Used for hover lifts, entrances, and state changes — never decorative looping animation on data views.

standard.$description: Default for elements moving within the screen.

fade-up.$description: Default entrance for cards, list items, toasts. Pairs with duration.slow + easing.entrance.
